fact: From 13 July 2026 SRC caps cheque payments of tax at R200,000, falling to R100,000 in 2027 and R50,000 in 2028, with no cheques after 31 December 2028; payments above the ceiling go through direct electronic transfer, point-of-sale or other digital channels.
title: Seychelles Revenue Commission Sets Cheque Phase-Out by 2028
